pages.text: The Fruit Press makes $(o)juice$() from grapes or apples. The juice can then be fermented into $(l:cellar/wines_and_ciders)Wines and Ciders$().
Add fruit to the press, then activate the piston top with a redstone signal. A lever attached to the top works well.$(br2)Drainage particles appear while the press is processing.
Most fruit press recipes produce 250 mB of juice per fruit, so four fruit will fill one bucket.
